metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code plugins: a guarded slice workflow, an interview-driven living-document workflow, Inspect AI eval discipline, and session-start environment bootstrap

plugins.name: sp
plugins.description: Guarded slice workflow: /sp:refine → /sp:start → /sp:implement → /sp:commit → /sp:push → /sp:done. TDD, atomic commits, worktree-per-slice, each step guards the previous one.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Interview-driven living-document workflow — builds a PRD (or any contested doc) section by section, interrogating old claims against evidence instead of merging them unreviewed.

plugins.name: evalcraft
plugins.description: Inspect-AI eval discipline: scorer refinement skill (deterministic-first, escalation judges), report fact-check skill, and a skeptical eval-methodology reviewer agent.

plugins.name: env-setup
plugins.description: Idempotent SessionStart bootstrap for a pinned gitleaks binary, so a repo's fail-closed secret-scan pre-commit hook has what it needs.

plugins.name: env-setup-browser
plugins.description: Optional SessionStart bootstrap that installs Playwright's Chromium browser for repos doing browser-based visual UI verification.
